integrity_notes: Analytical proof and a separate executable finite checker are included. No proof is claimed from finite enumerations, and no independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas require 1 <= m <= n-1 deleted cycle edges; the central limit theorem requires m/n in a compact interior limit.
Intrinsic volumes have changing dimension; the cross-polytope normalization is part of the geometric invariant.
The gram determinant and rooted-forest enumeration are classical; novelty is asserted only for the combined conditional geometric law and strict mean-versus-typical analysis.
Priority remains provisional against unindexed fixed-part composition literature, and independent mathematical auditing has not been performed.
title: A one-third deletion optimum and an exponential volume-moment gap for cycle-root polytopes
